items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: I did the original “Three Penny Opera” down in the Villages with Lottie Lenya and Bea Arthur... Jerry Orbach was in the show... We all did “Three Penny Opera” for scale.

ctx.x: And you had, was there like a six month period or something—

I had a six month period and I had to transfer, I transferred from the Rochester local which was my home local. It took six months. And you could do casuals, you could single dates, which I did, and that sustained me while I was waiting for the 802. And then when I got the 802, the New York Union Card, then I could take a steady job. And then I took a steady job that paid $85 a week, which was nothing. I did the original “Three Penny Opera” down in the Villages with Lottie Lenya and Bea Arthur. Oh you should have…
I would say it has to. Who were some of your most favorite fellow musicians that you associated with?
